inlines.v: DAUGHTER, noun, 1. The female offspring of a man or woman; a female child of any age. 2. A daughter in law; a son's wife. Ruth 3:1. 3. A woman; plural female inhabitants. Dinah went out to see the daughters of the land. Genesis 34:1. 4. A female descendant; lineage of females. Luke I. 5. The female penitent of a confessor. This word is used in scripture for the inhabitants of a city or country, male and female. Isaiah 16:1, Matthew 21:5. Also as a term of affection or kindness. Daughter, be of good comfort. Matthew 9:22.
